title: Polynomial-Time Serialization After Additive Relabeling
statement: Let $F$ map bit strings to CNF formulas over natural-number-indexed variables, and let $o$ map bit strings to natural numbers. If the function sending $x$ to the binary serialization of $F(x)$ is polynomial-time computable, and the function sending $x$ to the unary string of $o(x)$ ones is polynomial-time computable, then the function sending $x$ to the binary serialization of the formula obtained from $F(x)$ by replacing each variable index $j$ by $o(x)+j$ is polynomial-time computable.
hypotheses_covered: A function $F$ from bit strings to CNF formulas over natural-number-indexed variables.
A function $o$ from bit strings to natural numbers.
The binary serialization of $F(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
The unary encoding of $o(x)$ is polynomial-time computable.
